visual_review.main: All four native boards and both independent search results viewed with the same 160-pixel AHD and Noisy Malvar panels. Smooth sky, coherent coarse crossings, muted foliage and building wires.
visual_review.cab: Both 160-pixel ROIs with nominal and transferred shot/read, independent ISO100 AHD and both camera JPEGs viewed. Right transferred diagonals remain clearest. Left mottle and incomplete intersections persist.
visual_review.exact: Two 160-pixel comparison boards include both exact triplet renderings and were viewed. Window bars match visually. Clipped yellow transitions keep common color errors.
visual_review.outliers: Both 160-pixel worst-code boards viewed at the matched display exposure. Bright sign and light-reflection boundaries look alike.
